text: China's November data showed an unexpected contraction in manufacturing activity on both the private RatingDog/S&P PMI 949.9 vs 50.5 expected) and the official PMI (49.2, eight straight month below 5), alongside the first contraction in non-manufacturing since 2022.

meta.note: Third China macro-weakness signal this week (profits, prices/demand, now dual PMI contraction). Functions as an upstream collapse confirmation at the edge of the 11/30-12/2 Cycle-8 ignition window, showing demand compression and structural slowdown rather than a one-off print.
